calculation.description: Within lagged high-VIX-level regimes, rank assets by the negative three-session cumulative return. The VIX threshold and price signal are lagged and use only completed observations; neutral/unavailable dates are omitted. Forward validation target is five-session close-to-close return.

validation.regime_notes: Conditional activation is sparse (14.31% of calendar dates). Performance is mixed in early sparse history and positive in 2023-2026; uncertainty is material because the active sample is smaller than unconditional factors. The artifact is highly correlated with the contemporaneous VIX-shock reversal artifact and should not be double-counted.
